headline: Norwegian Fresh Salmon Export Price Edges Up to NOK 73.41 Per Kg
summary: Statistics Norway reported that the export price for fresh farmed salmon reached 73.41 NOK per kilogram in week 46 of 2026, up 0.1% from the previous week.
why: Norway is the world's largest exporter of farmed Atlantic salmon, making weekly export pricing a benchmark for the global seafood trade.

impacts.name: Norwegian Aquaculture Industry
impacts.why: Export price movements determine cash flows and profit margins for major Norwegian salmon producers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
